title: Protege, which offers an AI data platform to access high-quality, proprietary training data at scale, raised $30M from a16z, extending its $25M Series A (Duncan Riley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Duncan Riley / SiliconANGLE: Protege, which offers an AI data platform to access high-quality, proprietary training data at scale, raised $30M from a16z, extending its $25M Series A — Artificial intelligence data platform startup Protege Health Inc. today announced that it has raised $30 million in new funding.
